info.name: Lead Bank Account Number Events API

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the Event object you want to retrieve.

params.name: events
params.description: ID of the Event object you want to retrieve.

params.name: created_at
params.description: A set of filters on the list using the object’s field `created_at`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of objects to be returned.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination; this is an Event ID that defines your place in the list.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination; this is an Event ID that defines your place in the list.

params.name: object_id
params.description: Filter events by the ID of the associated object (e.g., wire_12345). If the object_id doesn't match the event filter's object type, returns empty results.
